customApiDefinition.name: alshaya_GetLocationDetails
customApiDefinition.description: Retrieve comprehensive location details including relationships (Key Personnel and Business Hours)

requestParameters.name: LocationId
requestParameters.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the location to retrieve

responseProperties.name: LocationDetails
responseProperties.description: JSON containing location data with Key Personnel and Business Hours included by default

responseProperties.name: ExecutionTime
responseProperties.description: Time taken to execute the API call in milliseconds

usage.description: Call this Custom API via Web API with a location GUID
